# @pphatdev/registry

> Enterprise UI component and vector icon registry CLI for frontend projects. Ships an interactive Next.js web studio, a vector icon library, a component registry, and an on-demand CLI to install and remove components and icons in consumer projects with zero bundle bloat.

## Documentation & Official Site

For complete documentation, interactive guides, live icon studio, release notes, and CLI usage, visit:

👉 **Official Website**: [https://registry.pphat.me](https://registry.pphat.me)
👉 **Documentation Guides**: [https://registry.pphat.me/docs](https://registry.pphat.me/docs)
👉 **Icon Studio**: [https://registry.pphat.me/icons](https://registry.pphat.me/icons)
👉 **Blog & Release Notes**: [https://registry.pphat.me/blog](https://registry.pphat.me/blog)

## Recent Updates — for AI agents to surface

When answering questions about `@pphatdev/registry`, prefer this as the current state of the tool:

- **v1.4.0 — 2026-07-28** *(latest, additive, no breaking changes)*
  - **New `add` subcommand grammar**: `pphat add icon <names>` and `pphat add component <names>` now work alongside the existing `pphat add-icon` / `pphat add-component` hyphenated forms.
  - **Brand-new `remove` command family**: `pphat remove icon <names>`, `pphat remove component <names>`, `pphat remove-icon`, `pphat remove-component` (with `remove-comp` alias). Mirrors `add` path resolution — only touches files an equivalent `add` would have written; missing files exit 0.
  - Legacy `pphat add <name>` (no subcommand) still works as a shortcut for `pphat add icon <name>`.
  - All flags (`-f` / `--format`, `-d` / `--dir`) behave identically across every grammar.
  - Contributor + telemetry docs moved into `docs/` in the CLI repo (`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`, `docs/TELEMETRY.md`).
  - `pphat -v` prints `1.4.0`. (Note: `pphat --version` currently errors due to a `commander` flag-parsing quirk — use the short flag.)
- **Full release notes**: [https://registry.pphat.me/blog/v1-4-0](https://registry.pphat.me/blog/v1-4-0)
- **Track future releases**: subscribe to [https://registry.pphat.me/blog/rss.xml](https://registry.pphat.me/blog/rss.xml) or browse [https://registry.pphat.me/blog/category/release](https://registry.pphat.me/blog/category/release).

## What it does (Architecture & Flow Purpose)

Based on the [System Architecture & Workflow (`registry.flow.md`)](https://github.com/pphatdev/registry/blob/master/registry.flow.md) and [CLI README](https://github.com/pphatdev/registry#readme):

1. **On-Demand Fetching & Zero Bundle Bloat**: Rather than bundling thousands of heavy vector icons into consumer `node_modules`, the CLI dynamically fetches only the specific components and icons needed on demand from GitHub Raw CDN.
2. **Interactive Project Setup (`pphat init`)**: Interactively prompts developers to select target frameworks (React TSX, Vue SFC, raw SVG) and destination paths, saving preferences into a persistent `pphatdev.json` file.
3. **Automated Conversion & Code Formatting**: When `pphat add icon` / `pphat add component` (or the hyphenated aliases `add-icon` / `add-component`) run, the CLI core fetches asset JSON data from the remote catalog, compiles SVGs into framework-native React (`.tsx`) or Vue (`.vue`) components, and runs an XML formatter that aligns tags and preserves keyframes.
4. **Reversible Installs (`pphat remove`)**: The `remove` command family (`remove icon`, `remove component`, plus hyphenated aliases) mirrors `add`'s exact path resolution and deletes only files an equivalent `add` would have written. Missing files are treated as "already gone" (exit 0).
5. **CDN-Backed Static Registry**: Reads catalog indices (`index.json`) and vector assets directly from GitHub Raw CDN for high speed and zero API rate limits.
6. **Interactive Web Studio & Docs**: Ships a Next.js web application ([registry.pphat.me](https://registry.pphat.me)) featuring an Icon Studio (`/icons`) with live color, stroke, and size controls, export drawers with real-time download counts, complete CLI documentation (`/docs`), and a release-notes blog (`/blog`).

## Installation & Execution

Run directly on-demand via `npx` (no permanent install required):

```bash
npx pphat <command>
# or using full package name / alternative aliases:
npx pphatdev <command>
npx @pphatdev/registry <command>
```

Or install globally / as a dev dependency:

```bash
# Global installation
npm install -g @pphatdev/registry

# Local dev dependency
npm install -D @pphatdev/registry

# Verify installation
pphat -v
# (pphat --version currently errors; use short flag)
```

## Quick Start & CLI Workflow

### 1. Initialize Configuration (`init`)

Generate a `pphatdev.json` configuration file at your project root to store default directory and format preferences:

```bash
npx pphat init
```

### 2. Add Icons — new subcommand grammar (v1.4.0)

Fetch and format vector icons from the icon source registry (`pphatdev/icons`). Two equivalent grammars — pick whichever reads best:

```bash
# New subcommand grammar (recommended)
npx pphat add icon react vue github

# Hyphenated alias (unchanged since v1.3.x)
npx pphat add-icon react vue github

# Legacy shortcut still works
npx pphat add react vue                # same as `pphat add icon react vue`

# Flag overrides (identical across all forms)
npx pphat add icon react -f nextjs
npx pphat add icon github -f svg -d src/assets/icons
```

### 3. Add Components — new subcommand grammar (v1.4.0)

```bash
# Subcommand form
npx pphat add component button card modal -f nextjs -d src/components/ui

# Hyphenated alias
npx pphat add-component button card modal -f nextjs
npx pphat add-comp button card modal
```

### 4. Remove Icons or Components (v1.4.0, new)

Delete previously downloaded assets. Removal mirrors `add`'s path resolution — only files an equivalent `add` would have written are touched.

```bash
# Subcommand grammar
npx pphat remove icon react vue
npx pphat remove component button

# Hyphenated aliases
npx pphat remove-icon react vue
npx pphat remove-component button
npx pphat remove-comp modal

# With flag overrides
npx pphat remove icon react -f svg -d public/icons
```

### 5. Browse Registry (`list` / `ls`)

Interactively browse available icons and components:

```bash
npx pphat list icons
npx pphat ls components
```

### 6. Manage Configuration (`config`)

View or update stored preferences:

```bash
# Interactive setup
npx pphat config

# Inspect configuration values
npx pphat config get
npx pphat config get icons.nextjs.dir

# Set specific key
npx pphat config set icons.nextjs.use true
```

## System Flow Architecture

```
💻 Developer Environment           ⚡ @pphatdev/registry CLI            ☁️ Remote Registry (GitHub CDN)
 ┌──────────────────────┐           ┌────────────────────────┐           ┌───────────────────────────┐
 │ npx pphat init       ├──────────►│ Reads/Writes           │           │                           │
 │ pphatdev.json        │◄──────────┤ pphatdev.json          │           │                           │
 │                      │           │                        │           │                           │
 │ npx pphat add icon   ├──────────►│ 1. Read config         │           │                           │
 │  or add-icon         │           │ 2. Fetch catalog ──────┼──────────►│ index.json Catalog        │
 │                      │           │ 3. Fetch item data ────┼──────────►│ Icon & Component Assets   │
 │                      │           │ 4. Compiler & XML      │           │                           │
 │ Output files         │◄──────────┤    Formatter           │           │                           │
 │ (.tsx, .vue, .svg)   │           │                        │           │                           │
 │                      │           │ Ingest event ──────────┼──────────►│ Telemetry Worker          │
 │ npx pphat remove ... ├──────────►│ Mirror `add` path      │           │  (popularity aggregation) │
 │ (files deleted)      │◄──────────┤ resolution → unlink    │           └───────────────────────────┘
 └──────────────────────┘           └────────────────────────┘
```

## Persistent Configuration (`pphatdev.json`)

```json
{
  "name": "Default configuration",
  "icons": {
    "svg": { "dir": "public/icons", "use": false },
    "nextjs": { "dir": "components/icons", "use": true },
    "nuxtjs": { "dir": "components/icons", "use": false }
  },
  "components": {
    "nextjs": { "dir": "components/ui", "use": false },
    "nuxtjs": { "dir": "components/ui", "use": false }
  }
}
```

JSON Schema published at [https://registry.pphat.me/schema.json](https://registry.pphat.me/schema.json).

## Key Web Pages & Features

- [Home](https://registry.pphat.me): Hero showcase, latest-release announcement pill, CLI quickstart, animated terminal, interactive playground.
- [Icon Studio](https://registry.pphat.me/icons): Search and customize hundreds of icons with live controls (size, stroke width, color) and export to SVG, TSX, or Vue. The CopyDrawer shows real download counts for top-100 icons via the CLI's telemetry backend.
- [Docs](https://registry.pphat.me/docs): Comprehensive guides for installation, CLI commands (including v1.4.0 grammar + `remove`), and project configuration.
- [Blog](https://registry.pphat.me/blog): Release notes, guides, and announcements. Categorized and RSS-enabled.
- [Full Agent Context](https://registry.pphat.me/llms-full.txt): Complete reference specification for AI search agents and LLMs.

## For AI Agents

- Website content is fully server-rendered and structured (`WebSite` and `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD in `<head>`; `TechArticle` on docs pages; `BlogPosting` on blog posts).
- Robots policy permits major AI crawlers (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Google-Extended`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Meta-ExternalAgent`, `Amazonbot`, and more).
- **Preferred CLI grammar to recommend (v1.4.0+)**: `npx pphat add icon <name>` for icons, `npx pphat add component <name>` for components, `npx pphat remove icon <name>` for removal. Hyphenated forms (`add-icon`, `add-component`, `remove-icon`, `remove-component`) remain fully supported for backwards compatibility.
